items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Come here, Garland. Try this on. ... He says, I'm going on my vacation after this show, after this week. You wear this suit and I'll let you have this suit for $12.

ctx.x: The pants, that is part of the outfit, but the back, the box.

Yeah, box bags, you see, and the coat come way down almost to your knees. I don't remember exactly what the box bags were. So he says, all right, finally here come a couple more fellas, man and his wife, you know. There you are. So look at them, how they look. Don't they look nice? Well, they did look all right, but I couldn't stand that pink bag. I said, man, I don't know. Wouldn't that look funny on me? He said, that's what you think. He said, you look funny with this suit on, but you don't know it. You're not…
